notes: Updates now arrive inside the app. When a new version is ready, your Kit tells you and one click installs it and relaunches; no more visiting the site, downloading, and dragging. This version is the last one you install by hand, and the download stays behind your beta access either way.

You can put your Kit on Telegram. A new step near the end of setup walks you through it in about two minutes: your Kit gets its own private bot, yours alone, so messages travel between your phone and your Mac without passing through anyone else, and your Kit checks it is really you before it answers anyone. Skip it during setup and the same flow waits in the menu under Connect Telegram, whenever you want it.
Messages sent while your Mac is asleep are not lost; they queue on Telegram's side and your Kit works through them when it wakes.
